purpose: Teach: 芋/熱帯/草原/銭湯/子犬/離島/自伝/自家製

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、芋を使ったメニュー、覚えた。
lines.en: We learned how to make this yam dish in home-ec. It was actually pretty cool.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick pace, like she's sharing something small but genuine. Light energy — not performing, just including him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。地理で、熱帯気候、習った。
lines.en: Yeah? We covered tropical climates in geography.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment. Not matching her energy exactly — more observant, slightly withdrawn. Pause before the second thought, like he's connecting things.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、広い草原、楽しみだ。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to the school trip. All those wide grasslands…
lines.style: Animated, genuine excitement. Opening attack on the anticipation. Slight dreamy trailing-off on the grasslands — she's already picturing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活帰り、銭湯、寄ろうか。
lines.en: Should we hit the sento after club? I could use it.
lines.style: Easier, more present than before. Light, almost conversational. The suggestion carries a quiet invitation — not pushing, just offering. Slight downward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お隣、子犬が、生まれたんだって。
lines.en: Oh, and the neighbors — they got a puppy. Just found out.
lines.style: Bright shift back. Quick, like gossip that delights her. Infectious energy. Matter-of-fact close, like she's already moved on to the next thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 地理で、離島の経済、面白かった。
lines.en: Geography was actually interesting. We covered island economies and it just clicked.
lines.style: Reflective but warmer now. Slower than before, thinking aloud a little. Genuine appreciation in the voice — he's sharing something that matters, not just making conversation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 図書館で、スポーツ選手の自伝、借りた。
lines.en: I picked up this athlete's autobiography from the library. Couldn't put it down.
lines.style: Animated, genuine investment. Sharp opening attack on the action of picking it up. Breathless slightly — like she's still caught in it. Energy building.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科、自家製ジャム、初めて作った。
lines.en: I actually made homemade jam in home-ec. First time ever.
lines.style: Warm, almost shy pride. Quiet opening — pride without showing off. Pace softens on the accomplishment. Slight uplift at the end, like he's offering it to her to share.
